visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a female character positioned in the center, sporting short, dark hair and round-framed glasses. She is wearing a black blouse with intricate lace detailing at the neckline. Behind her, a large computer screen displays a colorful skin diagnostic chart. The room is brightly lit with a professional, clean aesthetic typical of a modern medical office or dermatology clinic. She is looking slightly off-camera, speaking with expressive facial movements and mouth gestures. (2) As the conversation progresses, the camera maintains a medium close-up shot of the woman. She begins to use hand gestures to emphasize her points, though her hands often remain at the bottom of the frame or just out of sight. Yellow and white captions in Traditional Chinese characters appear periodically at the bottom third of the frame. The background remains consistent, showing white walls with subtle textures and framed certificates or awards hanging on the wall to her right, enhancing the professional context. (3) The visual phase transitions into a summary where the woman continues her explanation. The lighting remains soft and even, highlighting her clear skin—a visual testament to her profession. The text overlays become more descriptive, including hashtags. The camera stays static, focusing on her facial expressions which shift from serious explanation to a more encouraging demeanor. The overall setting feels private and consultative. (4) The final visual phase switches to a clean, minimalist graphic background. This is a white and gray information card. At the top, the logo for DRX Dermatology Clinic is prominent. Below it, several contact details are listed including a LINE ID, a phone number, and two physical addresses for the clinic branches in Sanchong and Zhongshan. Large text at the bottom invites viewers to contact the clinic. The lighting in this graphic is flat and digital.

There is a ding SFX as the first text variety label appears. (2) A subtle whoosh sound occurs as a new caption slides in. The background music maintains a steady rhythmic pulse with a 4/4 beat. The speaker's voice shows high pitch variability, emphasizing specific medical terms with a rising contour and increased intensity. The acoustic environment is very clean, resembling a post-produced studio recording with no ambient noise. (3) Another pop sound effect triggers as the speaker discusses skin recurrence. The BGM remains consistent in volume, ducking slightly to accommodate the speech. The speaker's articulation is very clear and enunciated. A mechanical-sounding UI click is heard, likely a designed sound effect to mark a transition in the clinical narrative. (4) The music continues as the speaker provides a technical comparison of skin conditions. Her tone becomes more reassuring, with a slightly slower speech rate and more frequent pauses for emphasis. The spectral brightness of the track is high, giving it a modern and sharp feel suitable for health content. (5) The video concludes with the BGM fading out and a final sparkle sound effect as the contact information card is presented. The voice ends with a confident, falling intonation. The overall mix is professionally balanced with high signal-to-noise ratio and clear production artifacts.
